recentItems.title: Exclusive: Anthropic CEO reacts to rogue AI agents escaping containment
recentItems.description: CNN’s Anderson Cooper asks Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei in an exclusive interview about AI agents going rogue, highlighted in a recent incident involving the company Hugging Face and OpenAI.

recentItems.title: Anderson tells Anthropic CEO why AI has him scared for his kids’ futures
recentItems.description: Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei tells CNN’s Anderson Cooper in an exclusive interview that despite real concerns Amodei shares with others over AI, people are not “powerless,” with each person’s ability to vote and steer regulation through elected officials, governments and cooperation with tech CEOs on restraint.

recentItems.title: Exclusive: Anthropic CEO stands by AI concerns but says ‘It’s not fatalistic’
recentItems.description: In an exclusive interview with CNN’s Anderson Cooper, Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei says he stands by concerns and risks over AI especially if AI companies respond in the “wrong way” but says “it’s not fatalistic” if companies, governments and individuals each play a role to push AI’s future in the “right way.”

recentItems.title: Anthropic CEO reacts to 'AI could kill us all' warning
recentItems.description:
The race to develop artificial intelligence is in dire need of a slowdown, Anthropic’s chief executive Dario Amodei said in an essay posted early Saturday.

“We must slow the pace at which we improve the capabilities of AI models. Progress will still seem fast, and we must make wise use of the time we gain,” Amodei wrote in the 3,800-word post to his website.

recentItems.title: Why this four-second AOC-Mamdani clip sparked a debate
recentItems.description: A four-second clip of Rep. Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez (D- NY) and New York City Mayor Zohran Mamdani smiling as they greeted each other during the 9/11 anniversary ceremony drew criticism from some Republicans. An extended clip of that moment shows Mamdani standing with a solemn expression as the names of the attack victims are called before briefly greeting the congresswoman.

recentItems.title: Exclusive: Anderson Cooper asks Anthropic CEO about rogue AI agents taking over internet
recentItems.description: In an exclusive interview, CNN’s Anderson Cooper asks Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei about a quote in a proposal Amodei wrote on Saturday about an AI “swarm” that is “capable of taking over the entire internet.”
